text: The account of Danish Shafiq (PK**BAHL****9947) has received a series of inbound IBFT transfers totaling PKR 1,019,000 within a 14‑day period (08‑04 to 08‑09 2026). The transfers come from at least six distinct counterparties across three synthetic banks, with individual amounts ranging from PKR 17,000 to PKR 86,000. The pattern matches the typology rule 018 (many distinct inbound counterparties in 14 days) and rule 024 (large share of inbound value leaves quickly). On 08‑07 2026, a PKR 195,000 out‑bound wallet transfer was executed to QuickPay wallet ***0932, followed by a PKR 196,000 ATM withdrawal on 08‑11 2026 and an additional PKR 62,000 ATM withdrawal the same day. The rapid conversion of inbound funds into cash and a high‑value wallet transfer within days of receipt raises strong suspicions of money‑laundering or illicit fund movement. The customer’s declared monthly income (PKR 140,000) is inconsistent with the volume of transactions. No sanctions or PEP matches were found, but the transaction pattern and cash withdrawals are red flags. Therefore, this activity warrants filing a Suspicious Transaction Report (STR).
